caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model with different amounts of trainable weights, as indicated by the title "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny". The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 in integer steps, while the y-axis shows the WER, ranging from 30 to 70. The legend identifies five different fine-tuning configurations: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" (solid gray line with circle markers), "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" (solid gray line with square markers), "tiny int4" (dashed gray line with circle markers), "tiny int8" (dashed gray line with square markers), and "tiny full" (dotted gray line with triangle markers). All five lines show a general downward trend in WER as the number of epochs increases. At epoch 0, the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" and "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" lines start at the highest WER, approximately 69 and 60 respectively. The "tiny int4" and "tiny int8" lines start at a WER of approximately 60 and 50 respectively. The "tiny full" line starts at a WER of approximately 30. By epoch 6, the WER for all configurations has decreased, with the "tiny full" line ending at the lowest WER of approximately 22. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" and "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" lines converge to a WER of approximately 40, while the "tiny int4" and "tiny int8" lines converge to a WER of approximately 37. The "tiny full" line shows the most significant improvement, decreasing by over 70% from its initial value.
